name: Tokidoki Sora o Miagete...
original_name: ときどき晴天を見上げて…
source:
Main character lives in the small town happily. But father remarries bringing step mother and step sister to the family. Soon both parents get into a traffic accident and die. The children decide to live together as a family and keep positive attitude.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
